text.title: 食物去了哪里
text.situation:
下一张桌上放着取食记录。片段里，捕食者追踪猎物，展示肉食动物猎食。另一片段里，草食动物吃叶。乔打开杂食动物照片，旁边说明它吃的不同食物。影片结尾，食腐动物吃另一只动物留下的残骸。玛雅追溯每顿食物的来源，在记录上追踪。

乔：片中每只动物都在捕猎吗？
露丝：不是。看它怎样获得食物，不只看是否吃肉。
玛雅：所以这只食腐动物在吃留下的东西？
露丝：在这个片段里是这样。动物可能有多种取食方式。

paragraphs.en: A feeding record lay on the next table. In one clip, a predator followed its prey; the scene showed a carnivore hunting for food. Another clip showed a herbivore feeding on leaves. Jo then opened a photograph of an omnivore beside a note about the different foods it ate. At the end of the film, a scavenger fed on remains left by another animal. Maya traced each meal back to its source on the record.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is every animal in the film hunting?
Ruth: No. Look at how it gets food, not just whether it eats meat.
Maya: So this scavenger is feeding on what was left?
Ruth: In this clip, yes. An animal may feed in more than one way.
